choose.when: SELECT COALESCE(v.frame_sn,(SELECT code FROM bike_production_scan sc WHERE sc.task_id=t.id AND sc.code_type='FRAME'),'-') AS `车架 SN`, COALESCE((SELECT CASE sc.code_type WHEN 'FRAME' THEN '车架' WHEN 'MOTOR' THEN '电机' WHEN 'BATTERY' THEN '电池' ELSE '仪表' END FROM bike_production_scan sc WHERE sc.task_id=t.id ORDER BY sc.id DESC LIMIT 1),'待扫码') AS `当前工位`, CONCAT((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_production_scan sc WHERE sc.task_id=t.id),' / 4') AS `完成进度`, COALESCE((SELECT sc.operator_name FROM bike_production_scan sc WHERE sc.task_id=t.id ORDER BY sc.id DESC LIMIT 1),t.created_by) AS `操作员`, t.created_at AS `开始时间`,CASE t.status WHEN 'OPEN' THEN '作业中' WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' ELSE '已取消' END AS `状态`,t.id AS `任务号` FROM bike_production_task t LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.id=t.vehicle_id ORDER BY t.updated_at DESC

SELECT CONCAT('V', LPAD(v.id, 10, '0')) AS `整车编号`, v.frame_sn AS `车架 SN`, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'MOTOR' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END), '-') AS `电机 SN`, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'BATTERY' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END), '-') AS `电池 SN`, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN b.part_type = 'DISPLAY' AND b.is_current = 1 THEN b.part_sn END), '-') AS `仪表 SN`, CASE v.status WHEN 0 THEN '待组装' WHEN 1 THEN '组装完成' WHEN 2 THEN '已入库' WHEN 3 THEN '已出库' WHEN 4 THEN '返工中' WHEN 5 THEN '售后维修' WHEN 6 THEN '报废' ELSE '未知' END AS `整车状态`, COALESCE(m.model_name, '-') AS `车型`, v.assemble_time AS `组装时间`, v.stock_in_time AS `入库时间`, v.stock_out_time AS `出库时间`, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '-') AS `客户`, COALESCE(v.current_order_no, '-') AS `订单`, COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '-') AS `仓库`, COALESCE(l.location_name, '-') AS `库位`, COALESCE(sku.sku_code,'历史未关联') AS `SKU`, COALESCE(pv.batch_no,'-') AS `生产批次` FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id = v.model_id LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle_part_binding b ON b.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = v.current_customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id = v.current_warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id = v.current_location_id LEFT JOIN bike_production_vehicle pv ON pv.vehicle_id=v.id LEFT JOIN bike_production_sku sku ON sku.id=pv.sku_id GROUP BY v.id, v.frame_sn, m.model_name, v.status, v.assemble_time ORDER BY v.updated_at DESC

SELECT model_name AS `车型`,COALESCE(warehouse_name,'无在库车辆') AS `仓库`,COALESCE(location_name,'-') AS `库位`, physical_qty AS `物理库存`,locked_qty AS `锁定库存`,available_qty AS `分摊可新增上限`,age_days AS `库龄`,stock_in_date AS `入库日期`,quarantined_qty AS `隔离库存`, temporary_locked_qty AS `临时锁定`,order_reserved_qty AS `订单占用`,shortage_qty AS `库存缺口`, sku_shortage_qty AS `车型SKU缺口（不累计）`,legacy_model_committed_qty AS `历史车型承诺（不累计）`,model_new_commitment_qty AS `车型可新增上限（不累计）` FROM inventory_projection p WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_agent_model_access access JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=access.agent_id AND a.status='ENABLED' JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=access.model_id AND m.enabled=1 WHERE access.agent_id=#{agentId} AND access.model_id=p.model_id AND access.enabled=1) ORDER BY physical_qty DESC,model_id,warehouse_id,location_id

SELECT si.stock_in_no AS `业务单号`, '整车入库' AS `类型`, '1 台' AS `整车数量`, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '-'), ' / ', COALESCE(l.location_name, '-')) AS `客户 / 仓库`, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') AS `操作人`, si.operation_time AS `操作时间`, CASE si.status WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已撤销' ELSE si.status END AS `状态` FROM bike_stock_in_record si LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id = si.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id = si.location_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id = si.operator_id ORDER BY si.operation_time DESC

SELECT so.stock_out_no AS `业务单号`, '整车出库' AS `类型`, '1 台' AS `整车数量`, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '-') AS `客户 / 仓库`, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') AS `操作人`, so.operation_time AS `操作时间`, CASE so.status WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已撤销' ELSE so.status END AS `状态` FROM bike_stock_out_record so LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id = so.operator_id ORDER BY so.operation_time DESC

SELECT stock_no AS `业务单号`, type AS `类型`, '1 台' AS `整车数量`, destination AS `客户 / 仓库`, operator_name AS `操作人`, operation_time AS `操作时间`, status AS `状态` FROM (SELECT si.stock_in_no stock_no, '整车入库' type, CONCAT(COALESCE(w.warehouse_name, '-'), ' / ', COALESCE(l.location_name, '-')) destination, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') operator_name, si.operation_time, CASE si.status WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已撤销' ELSE si.status END status FROM bike_stock_in_record si LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id = si.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.id = si.location_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id = si.operator_id UNION ALL SELECT so.stock_out_no, '整车出库', COALESCE(c.customer_name, '-'), COALESCE(u.display_name, '-'), so.operation_time, CASE so.status WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已撤销' ELSE so.status END FROM bike_stock_out_record so LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = so.customer_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id = so.operator_id) records ORDER BY operation_time DESC

SELECT o.order_no AS `订单号`, c.customer_name AS `客户`, m.model_name AS `车型`, CONCAT(i.ordered_qty, ' 台') AS `订单数量`, CONCAT(i.shipped_qty, ' 台') AS `已出库`, o.planned_ship_date AS `计划发货`, CASE o.status WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN '草稿' WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN '待出库' WHEN 'PARTIAL_SHIPPED' THEN '部分出库' WHEN 'SHIPPED' THEN '已完成' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已作废' WHEN 'CLOSED' THEN '已关闭' ELSE o.status END AS `状态`, il.lock_no AS `来源锁定`, NULLCASE WHEN r.hold_mode='PAID' THEN NULL ELSE r.expires_at END AS `占用截止`, CASE WHEN r.order_id IS NULL THEN '未占用' WHEN o.status IN ('CANCELLED','CLOSED') OR r.hold_mode='RELEASED' THEN '已释放' WHEN i.shipped_qty>=i.ordered_qty THEN '已履约' WHEN r.hold_mode='PAID' THEN '有效''收款达标保留，待人工关闭' WHEN r.expires_at<=NOW(3) THEN '已到期' ELSE '有效' END AS `占用状态`, o.remark AS `备注` FROM bike_sales_order o JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN bike_sales_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id = i.product_model_id LEFT JOIN bike_order_reservation r ON r.order_id=o.id LEFT JOIN bike_inventory_lock il ON il.id=r.source_lock_id WHERE o.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY o.created_at DESC

SELECT agent_code AS `代理商编号`, agent_name AS `代理商名称`, COALESCE(contact_name, '-') AS `联系人`, COALESCE(contact_phone, '-') AS `联系电话`, CASE status WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN '启用' ELSE status END AS `状态`, updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_agent ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT COALESCE(a.agent_name,'直接客户') AS `代理商`, m.model_name AS `车型`, CONCAT(CASE WHEN il.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND il.expire_time>NOW(3) THEN il.lock_qty-il.released_qty-il.converted_qty ELSE 0 END, ' 台') AS `有效临时锁定`, il.expire_time AS `有效期`, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_order_reservation r WHERE r.source_lock_id=il.id) AS `关联订单数`, COALESCE(u.display_name,'历史未记录') AS `创建人`, CASE WHEN il.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND il.expire_time<=NOW(3) THEN '已到期' ELSE CASE il.status WHEN 'LOCKED' THEN '锁定中' WHEN 'PARTIAL_CONVERTED' THEN '部分转订单' WHEN 'CONVERTED' THEN '已转订单' WHEN 'RELEASED' THEN '已释放' WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN '已到期' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE il.status END END AS `状态`,il.lock_no AS `锁定单号` FROM bike_inventory_lock il LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=il.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=il.product_model_id LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=il.created_by WHERE il.agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY il.created_at DESC

SELECT il.lock_no AS `锁定单号`, COALESCE(a.agent_name,'直接客户') AS `代理商`, m.model_name AS `车型`, il.lock_qty AS `锁定数量`, il.released_qty AS `已释放`, il.converted_qty AS `已转订单`, il.expire_time AS `到期时间`, CASE WHEN il.status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND il.expire_time<=NOW(3) THEN '已到期' ELSE CASE il.status WHEN 'LOCKED' THEN '锁定中' WHEN 'PARTIAL_CONVERTED' THEN '部分转订单' WHEN 'CONVERTED' THEN '已转订单' WHEN 'RELEASED' THEN '已释放' WHEN 'EXPIRED' THEN '已到期' WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE il.status END END AS `状态` FROM bike_inventory_lock il LEFT JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=il.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=il.product_model_id il.agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY il.created_at DESC

SELECT model_name AS `车型`,COALESCE(warehouse_name,'无在库车辆') AS `仓库`,COALESCE(location_name,'-') AS `库位`, physical_qty AS `物理库存`,locked_qty AS `锁定库存`,available_qty AS `分摊可新增上限`,age_days AS `库龄`,stock_in_date AS `入库日期`,quarantined_qty AS `隔离库存`, temporary_locked_qty AS `临时锁定`,order_reserved_qty AS `订单占用`,shortage_qty AS `库存缺口`, sku_shortage_qty AS `车型SKU缺口（不累计）`,legacy_model_committed_qty AS `历史车型承诺（不累计）`,model_new_commitment_qty AS `车型可新增上限（不累计）` FROM inventory_projection p WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bike_agent_model_access access JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=access.agent_id AND a.status='ENABLED' JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=access.model_id AND m.enabled=1 WHERE access.agent_id=#{agentId} AND access.model_id=p.model_id AND access.enabled=1) ORDER BY physical_qty DESC,model_id,warehouse_id,location_id

SELECT COALESCE(l.frame_sn, l.business_id, '-') AS `查询对象`, COALESCE(v.frame_sn, '-') AS `整车 / 车架`, COALESCE(CASE v.status WHEN 0 THEN '待组装' WHEN 1 THEN '组装完成' WHEN 2 THEN '已入库' WHEN 3 THEN '已出库' ELSE '其他' END, '-') AS `当前状态`, l.action AS `最近操作`, COALESCE(v.current_order_no, '-') AS `订单号`, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '-') AS `客户`, l.operation_time AS `查询时间` FROM bike_operation_log l LEFT JOIN bike_vehicle v ON v.frame_sn = l.frame_sn LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id = v.current_customer_id WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY l.operation_time DESC

SELECT p.part_sn AS `零部件 SN`, p.part_type AS `类型`, COALESCE(s.supplier_name, '-') AS `供应商`, COALESCE(p.batch_no, '-') AS `批次`, CASE p.bind_status WHEN 'BOUND' THEN '已绑定' ELSE '未绑定' END AS `绑定状态`, COALESCE(p.current_frame_sn, '-') AS `当前车架`, p.status AS `状态` FROM bike_part p LEFT JOIN bike_supplier s ON s.id = p.supplier_id ORDER BY p.updated_at DESC

SELECT customer_code AS `客户编号`, customer_name AS `客户名称`, COALESCE(contact_name, '-') AS `联系人`, COALESCE(contact_phone, '-') AS `联系电话`, CASE status WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN '启用' ELSE status END AS `状态`, created_at AS `创建时间` FROM bike_customer ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT supplier_code AS `供应商编号`, supplier_name AS `供应商名称`, COALESCE(contact_name, '-') AS `联系人`, COALESCE(contact_phone, '-') AS `联系电话`, CASE status WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN '启用' ELSE status END AS `状态`, created_at AS `创建时间` FROM bike_supplier ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT model_code AS `车型编码`, model_name AS `车型名称`, CASE enabled WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END AS `启用状态`, updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_product_model ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT w.warehouse_name AS `仓库`, COALESCE(l.location_name, '-') AS `库位`, COALESCE(l.location_code, '-') AS `库位编码`, CASE COALESCE(l.status, w.status) WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN '启用' ELSE COALESCE(l.status, w.status) END AS `状态`, COALESCE(l.updated_at, w.updated_at) AS `更新时间` FROM bike_warehouse w LEFT JOIN bike_warehouse_location l ON l.warehouse_id = w.id ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC
SELECT username AS `用户名`, display_name AS `姓名`, user_type AS `账号类型`, CASE enabled WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END AS `启用状态`, last_login_at AS `最近登录` FROM bike_sys_user ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT r.role_code AS `角色编码`, r.role_name AS `角色名称`, COUNT(rp.permission_id) AS `权限数量`, CASE r.enabled WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END AS `启用状态`, r.updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_sys_role r LEFT JOIN bike_sys_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id GROUP BY r.id ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC

SELECT workstation_code AS `工位编码`, workstation_name AS `工位名称`, workstation_type AS `工位类型`, CASE enabled WHEN 1 THEN '启用' ELSE '停用' END AS `启用状态`, updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_workstation ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT operation_time AS `时间`, action AS `操作`, COALESCE(frame_sn, business_id, '-') AS `业务对象`, COALESCE(operator_name, '-') AS `操作人`, business_type AS `业务类型`, COALESCE(remark, '-') AS `备注` FROM bike_operation_log WHERE 1=1 ORDER BY operation_time DESC

SELECT v.frame_sn AS `车架 SN`, COALESCE(m.model_name, '-') AS `车型`, COALESCE(v.vehicle_qr_code, '-') AS `总二维码`, COALESCE(c.customer_name, '-') AS `客户`, COALESCE(v.current_order_no, '-') AS `订单号`, v.stock_out_time AS `出库时间`, '待申报' AS `报关状态` FROM bike_vehicle v LEFT JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=v.model_id LEFT JOIN bike_customer c ON c.id=v.current_customer_id WHERE v.status=3 ORDER BY v.stock_out_time DESC

SELECT w.warehouse_name AS `仓库`, w.warehouse_code AS `仓库编码`, l.location_name AS `库位`, l.location_code AS `库位编码`, CASE l.status WHEN 'ENABLED' THEN '启用' ELSE l.status END AS `状态`, l.updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_warehouse_location l JOIN bike_warehouse w ON w.id=l.warehouse_id ORDER BY l.updated_at DESC

SELECT r.rework_no AS `返工单号`, r.frame_sn AS `车架 SN`, r.reason AS `返工原因`, r.status AS `状态`, COALESCE(u.display_name, '-') AS `操作人`, r.operation_time AS `操作时间` FROM bike_rework_record r LEFT JOIN bike_sys_user u ON u.id=r.operator_id ORDER BY r.operation_time DESC
SELECT config_key AS `配置键`, config_value AS `配置值`, COALESCE(remark, '-') AS `说明`, updated_at AS `更新时间` FROM bike_system_config ORDER BY updated_at DESC

SELECT a.agent_name AS `代理商`, m.model_name AS `授权车型`, i.intent_qty AS `意向数量`, i.expire_time AS `有效期`, i.status AS `状态` FROM bike_agent_purchase_intent i JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=i.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=i.product_model_id i.agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC
choose.otherwise: SELECT NULL AS `查询结果` WHERE 1 = 0

mapper.select: SELECT q.* FROM () q ORDER BY q.`${sortColumn}` DESC, q.`${columns[0]}` DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
